name: branch_a_chain
about: Card 405, branch A's chain (round r8b_repaired, frozen in session 5): the rules of round 8 (chain.json) unchanged; on the 24 pieces citing the 19 works card 398 repaired from raw PDF bytes every step reads answers given on the repaired texts (repaired_r8b.py build writes answers/r8b/). Card 405, branch A's chain (round r8_unsure_first, frozen in session 3: as r7s_objection_soft_unsure, but where Sonnet is unsure and Opus's neutral answer rejects with a reason, that rejection comes before the soft objection rule; r7s replaced round 5 r5_veto_haiku_only, which replaced card 397's round 4). Sonnet's no (neutral question) is final. Where a Haiku reader named an objection, Opus is shown it (questions/objection_v1.md): if Opus confirms the difference is real and changes the meaning, the piece is left undecided (Fable 5.2's softer rule: the hard rule rejected one right main-group piece). Sonnet's yes otherwise stands only when (1) Haiku asked again with the reworded question does not say not supported, or Sonnet asked the same reworded question says supported, and (2) Haiku (neutral question) names no difference in detail and no contradiction backed by a quote from the work, unless Opus judged that objection mistaken or a fair rewording. Where Sonnet is unsure, Opus's neutral answer decides: not supported with a named reason rejects; supported passes only when the reworded Haiku was asked and did not object. Everything else is left undecided. Gemma is not used. Run: ./venv/bin/python3 benchmarks/sprint_checker/branch_a/repaired_r8b.py combine benchmarks/sprint_checker/branch_a/chain.json --out <decisions file> (it reads the 19 repaired works for the quote checks; plain combine.py would read the raw PDF bytes).

rewording veto, Sonnet does not lift it
sonnet unsure, Opus approves, reworded Haiku does not object
